questions.question: A man started off a business with a certain capital amount. In the first year, he earned 60% profit and donated 50% of the total capital (initial amount + profit). He followed the same procedure with the remaining capital after the second and the third year. If at the end of the three years, he is left with Rs. 15,360, what was the initial amount (in Rs.) with which the man started his business?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Profit % = 60% on capital

Donation = 50% of total capital(initial amount + profit)

**Concept used:**

Total capital = Initial amount + profit

**Calculation:**

Let the captial at the starting be 100a

After 1st year, his capital = 100a + 100a × 60%

⇒ 160a

After donating, his capital = 160a - 160a × 50%

⇒ 80a

After 2nd year, his capital = 80a + 80a × 60%

⇒ 128a

After donating, his capital = 128a - 128a × 50%

⇒ 64a

After 3rd year, his capital = 64a + 64a × 60%

⇒ 102.4a

After donating, his capital = 102.4a - 102.4a × 50%

⇒ 51.2a

Here, in the question 51.2a = Rs. 15360

⇒ a = 300

⇒ 100a = 300 × 100 = Rs. 30000

So, his capital at the starting was Rs. 30000

**∴ The initial amount (in Rs.) with which the man started his business was 30000.**

questions.question: In a ΔABC, D, E and F are the mid-points of side BC, CA and AB respectively. If BC = 14.4 cm, CA = 15.2 cm and AB = 12.4 cm, what is the perimeter (in cm) of the ΔDEF?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

BC = 14.4 cm

CA = 15.2 cm

AB = 12.4 cm

**Concept used:**

Midpoint theorem - The line segment in a triangle joining the midpoint of two sides of the triangle is said to be parallel to its third side and is also half of the length of the third side.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/beca8e76edf7402aa46a23abd864b4b6e41e864f3f1f3a38db56fa52cea6190e.png] 

F and E are the mid point of AB and AC

So, according to the concept,

FE = (BC/2)

Similarly,

DE = (AB/2) and FD = (AC/2)

Now,

Perimeter of ΔDEF = DE + FE + FD

⇒ (BC/2) + (AB/2) + (AC/2)

⇒ 1/2(BC + AB + AC)

⇒ 1/2(14.4 + 12.4 + 15.2)

⇒ 1/2(42)

⇒ 21

**∴ The perimeter (in cm) of the ΔDEF is 21.**

questions.question: The profit earned by selling an article for Rs. 832 is equal to the loss incurred when the article is sold for Rs. 448. What should be the selling price (in Rs.) to make a profit of 10%?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Profit on selling the article in Rs. 832 = Loss on selling the article in Rs. 448

**Concept used:**

SP = CP + CP × profit%

Here,

SP = selling price

CP = cost price

**Calculation:**

Let CP be x

According to the question,

832 - x = x - 448

⇒ 832 + 448 = x + x

⇒ 1280 = 2x

⇒ x = 1280/2 = 640

Now,

To make 10% profit,

SP = 640 + 640 × 10%

⇒ 640 + 64

⇒ 704

So, SP = Rs. 704

**∴ The selling price (in Rs.) to make a profit of 10% is 704.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper offers his customers a discount of 10%. On an item marked at a price of Rs. 400, which was a little damaged, he offered additional discount of 10%. At what price (in Rs.) is the item available to customers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

MP of the item = Rs. 400

Discount % for 1st and 2nd = 10%

**Concept used:**

SP = MP - (MP × Discount%)

**Calculation:**

Price after 1st discount = 400 - (400 × 10%)

⇒ 360

Price after 2nd discount = 360 - (360 × 10%)

⇒ 324

So, the cost price of the customers after two discounts = Rs. 324

**∴ The item is available to customers at Rs. 324.**

questions.question: If 3 sin² θ + 4cos θ - 4 = 0, 0° °, then the value of (cosec² θ + cot² θ) is
questions.solution:
**Given:**

3sin²θ + 4cosθ - 4 = 0

**Formula used:**

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

Hypotenuse(H)² = Perpendicular(P)² + Base(B)² 

**Calculation:**

3sin2θ + 4cosθ - 4 = 0

⇒ 3(1 - cos2θ) + 4cosθ - 4 = 0

⇒ 3 - 3cos2θ + 4cosθ - 4 = 0

⇒ - 3cos2θ + 4cosθ - 1 = 0

⇒ 3cos2θ - 4cosθ + 1 = 0

⇒ 3cos2θ - 3cosθ - cosθ + 1 = 0

⇒ 3cosθ(cosθ - 1) - 1(cosθ - 1) = 0

⇒ (cosθ - 1)(3cosθ - 1) = 0

⇒ cosθ = 1, 1/3

But cosθ = 1 is not possible because it is given 0° 

So, cosθ = 1/3

Now,

Cosθ = B/H

So,

H² = B² + P²

⇒ 3² = 1² + P²

⇒ 9 = 1 + P2

⇒ 9 - 1 = P2

⇒ 8 = P2

⇒ 2√2 = P

So, cosec2θ + cot2θ = (3/2√2)² + (1/2√2)²

⇒ (9/8) + (1/8)

⇒ (9 + 1)/8

⇒ 10/8 = 5/4

**∴ The value of (cosec2 θ + cot2 θ) is (5)/(4).**

questions.question: From the body of a solid cube of edge 7 cm, a solid sphere is removed. The volume of the remaining solid was found to be {{163}}frac{{{1}}}{{{3}}} cm³. What is the diameter (in cm) of the sphere? (Take {{pi = }}frac{{{{22}}}}{{{7}}} )
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Edge of cube = 7cm

**Concept used:**

Volume of a cube = a³

Volume of a sphere = (4/3)πr³

Here,

a = side or edge of the cube

r = radius of the sphere

**Calculation:**

Let the radius of the sphere be x cm

According to the question,

a³ - (4/3)πr³ = {{163}}frac{{{1}}}{{{3}}}

⇒ 7³ - (4)/(3)πr³ = {{}}frac{{{490}}}{{{3}}}

⇒ 343 - {{}}frac{{{490}}}{{{3}}} = (4)/(3)πr3

⇒ {{}}frac{{{1029 - 490}}}{{{3}}} = (4)/(3)πr3

⇒ {{}}frac{{{539}}}{{{3}}} = (4)/(3)πr3

⇒ 539 = 4πr3

⇒ (539 × 7)/(22 × 4) = r3

⇒ 42.875 = r3

⇒ r = 3.5 cm

So, diameter = 3.5 × 2 = 7 cm

**∴ The diameter (in cm) of the sphere is 7.**

questions.question: A invested 30% more than B. B invested 40% less than C, who invested Rs. 8,000. The average of the total amount invested by all of them together (to the nearest Rs.) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A invested 30% more than B

B invested 40% less than C

Investment of C = Rs. 8000

**Concept used:**

Average = Sum of elements/No. of elements

**Calculation:**

Investment of B = 8000 - 8000 × 40%

⇒ Rs. 4800

Investment of A = 4800 + 4800 × 30%

⇒ Rs. 6240

Total investment of them = 6240 + 4800 + 8000

⇒ 19040

Average of the investment of them = 19040/3

⇒ Rs. 6346.67 ≈ Rs. 6347

**∴ The average of the total amount invested by all of them together (to the nearest Rs.) is 6347.**

14 men can complete a work in 15 days. If 21 men are employed, then in how many days will they complete the same work?
questions.solution:
Given:

14 men can complete a work in 15 days

Concept used:

M1 × D1 = M2 × D2

Here,

M1 = Men at the 1st case

D1 = Time at the 1st case

M2 = Men at the 2nd case

D2 = Time at the 2nd case 

Calculation:

According to the concept,

M1 = 14

D1 = 15

M2 = 21

Let D2 be x

So,

14 × 15 = 21 × x

⇒ 210 = 21x

⇒ x = 210/21

⇒ x = 10

So, D2 = 10 days

**∴ They will complete the same work in 10 days.**

questions.question: Of the three numbers, second is one-third of first and is also three-fourth of the third number. If the average of three numbers is 112, then what is the smallest number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of three numbers = 112

**Concept used:**

Average = sum of elements/no of elements

**Calculation:**

Total of three numbers = 112 × 3

⇒ 336

Let 2nd number be 3a

According to the question,

1st number × 1/3 = 3a 

⇒ 1st number = 3a × 3 = 9a

Again,

3rd number × 3/4 = 3a

⇒ 3rd number = 3a × (4/3) = 4a

Now,

9a + 3a + 4a = 336

⇒ 16a = 336

⇒ a = 336/16

⇒ a = 21

Smallest among three = 3 × 21 = 63

**∴ The smallest number is 63.**

questions.question:
The number of cars passing the road near a colony from 6 am to 12 noon has been shown in the following histogram. 

What is the maximum change percentage in the number of cars as compared to the previous hour? (correct to 2 decimal places)

questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

1) Cars during 6 to 7 = 70

Cars during 7 to 8 = 105

Increase in number of cars = 105 - 70 = 35

Percentage change = (35/70) × 100

⇒ 50% increase

 

2) Cars during 8 to 9 = 130

Increase in number of cars = 130 - 105 = 25

Percentage change = (25/105) × 100

⇒ 23.809% ≈ 23.81% increase

 

3) Cars during 9 to 10 = 115

Decreased in number of cars = 130 - 115 = 15

Percentage change = (15/130) × 100

⇒ 11.538% ≈ 11.54% decrease

 

4) Cars during 10 to 11 = 95

Decreased in number of cars = 115 - 95 = 20

Percentage change = (20/115) × 100

⇒ 17.391% ≈ 17.39% decrease

 

5) Cars during 11 to 12 = 45

Decreased in number of cars = 95 - 45 = 50

Percentage change = (50/95) × 100

⇒ 52.631% ≈ 52.63% decrease

**∴ Required answer is 52.63% decrease.**

Students studying humanities in 2019 and 2020 taken together is what percentage of the total number of students studying during the two years taken together? (correct to 2 decimal places)

questions.question: If each of the two numbers 5¹⁶ and 5²⁵ are divided by 6, the remainders are R₁ and R₂ respectively. What is the value of frac{{{{{R}}{₁}}{{ + }}{{{R}}{₂}}}}{{{{{R}}{₂}}}}?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two numbers 516 and 525 are divided by 6, the remainders are R1 and R2 respectively.

**Concept used:**

If a number in the form of (b - 1)ⁿ is divided by b

Then,

Remainder = 1 if n is an even number

Remainder = (b - 1) if n is an odd number

**Calculation:**

516 = (6 - 1)¹⁶

So, remainder = frac{(6 - 1)¹⁶}{6} = 1 i.e R₁

again,

525 = (6 - 1)25

So, remainder = frac{(6 - 1)²⁵}{6} = (6 - 1) = 5 i.e R2

Now, 

frac{{{{{R}}{₁}}{{ + }}{{{R}}{₂}}}}{{{{{R}}{₂}}}} = (1 + 5)/(5)

⇒ (6)/(5)

**∴ Required answer is (6)/(5)**.

questions.question: Three numbers are in the proportion of 3 : 8 : 15 and their LCM is 8280. What is their HCF?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the common factor (HCF) be x.

LCM of ratio terms (3, 8, 15) = 120.

We know: HCF × LCM of ratio parts = Actual LCM

x × 120 = 8280

x = 69

**∴ The correct answer is 69.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 Ratio & LCM Concept
 
 3x
 
 8x
 
 15x
 

 

 

 
 LCM = 120x = 8280

**Given:**

Three numbers are in the proportion of 3 : 8 : 15.

The LCM of the numbers = 8280.

**Concept Used:**

If numbers are given in a ratio a : b : c, they can be written as ax, bx, and cx where x is their HCF.

The LCM of (ax, bx, cx) is x × LCM(a, b, c).

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the three numbers be 3x, 8x, and 15x respectively.

⇒ LCM of the ratios (3, 8, and 15) = 120

⇒ LCM of the actual numbers = 120x

⇒ We are given that the LCM is 8280.

⇒ 120x = 8280

⇒ x = 8280 ÷ 120

⇒ x = 69

The common multiplier x is the Highest Common Factor (HCF) among the three numbers.

**∴ The correct answer is 69.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM and HCF of Co-prime Numbers

If two numbers a and b are co-prime, their Highest Common Factor (HCF) is 1 and their Least Common Multiple (LCM) is their product (a × b).

Product Rule for Two Numbers

For any two positive integers, the product of the numbers is always equal to the product of their HCF and LCM. Formula: First Number × Second Number = HCF × LCM. This applies generally to two numbers, not three.

LCM and HCF of Fractions

LCM of fractions = LCM of numerators ÷ HCF of denominators. HCF of fractions = HCF of numerators ÷ LCM of denominators.

questions.question: If x + y + z = 7, xy + yz + zx = 8, then what is the value of x³ + y³ + z³ - 3xyz?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x + y + z = 7

xy + yz + zx = 8

**Formula used:**

a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc = (a + b + c)[(a + b + c)² - 3(ab + bc + ac)]

**Calculation:**

Putting the values in the formula we get

x3 + y3 + z3 - 3xyz = 7 × (72 - 3 × 8)

⇒ 7 × (49 - 24)

⇒ 7 × 25

⇒ 175

**∴ The value of x3 + y3 + z3 - 3xyz is 175.**
